technical.summary: Solid multi-timeframe bullish structure with price above all major MAs and rising RSI(14/21), but volume weakness and lack of fresh momentum signals limit conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: No insider buying, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest create a weak fundamental setup with elevated earnings risk in 78 days.

sentiment.summary: No congressional signal; market in fear state (37/100) with bearish AAII sentiment (53%) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but lack of recent news data and stale congressional trades (6-10 months old) limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (342.6) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 78 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Multi-timeframe RSI bullish structure with price above all major MAs and StochRSI cross-up from oversold provides technical foundation for swing entry in fear-zone contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme VIX crisis regime (342.6), volume collapse (ratio <1), zero fundamental conviction, high earnings risk in 78 days, and price below Hull/TEMA short-term structure create overwhelming headwinds that outweigh technical setup.
